features: All-in-One Convenience: Print, scan, and copy with ease — all in one compact device with flatbed scanning and wireless functionality.
Smart Connectivity: Stay connected with Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and dual Hi-Speed USB 2.0 ports — perfect for seamless home & office use.
Vibrant, High-Speed Prints: Get sharp black-and-white and vivid color prints using HP GT53/GT52 ink bottles. Speeds up to 30 ppm (black) and 24 ppm (color).
Quick & Reliable: Enjoy fast print speeds — up to 30 ppm (black) and 24 ppm (color) — with auto duplex printing for time-saving efficiency.
Simple & Intuitive: Effortless navigation with a 2-line LCD and smart guided buttons for quick access to key functions.
Versatile Media Handling: 60-sheet input and 25-sheet output trays support A4, A5, A6, B5 (JIS), envelopes, and more.
Built for Volume: Handles up to 3,000 pages per month — ideal for high-volume home printing needs.
Wide Compatibility: Works seamlessly with Windows 11/10/7 and macOS 10.14 and above.
Dimensions (W×D×H): 460 mm × 380 mm × 190 mm. Auto Document Feeder (ADF) for multipage scanning. Automatic duplex (2-sided) printing. Use HP Original Inks for best performance & durability.
Peace of Mind: Backed by a 1-year warranty, with 12x7 voice support and 24x7 chat assistance available. Use HP Original Inks for best performance & durability.
